dedupe_keys.name: 避難検証法 hinan kensho ho evacuation safety verification software route b1 kozo system

description: This commercial Japanese software carries out the Route B1 evacuation safety verification calculations of the Building Standard Law, following MLIT notices 509, 510 and 511 of 2020. For floor evacuation it checks that everyone on a floor reaches a direct staircase before smoke and gas descend to a dangerous height; passing lets designers relax requirements such as smoke exhaust windows, smoke curtain walls, corridor widths and walking distances to stairs. Users enter complex floor plans, the software works out how rooms connect from the door positions, and it computes the longest walking time routes and the shortest smoke descent times automatically. Version 4, released on 1 September 2020, added compartment evacuation safety verification. Coverage: buildings designed under Japanese law. Access: sold by the company, with a trial version and catalogue. Licence: commercial. Caveats: a code-compliance calculation, not an agent-based egress simulation; Japanese only. Simulation uses are checking evacuation and smoke timing in hospital, school and office designs as part of fire safety of critical facilities. Related records: Pathfinder and FDS with Smokeview, which model egress and smoke in more detail.
